Hi Team Mahfil Cafe & Restaurant,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.3★ reviews near Phulwari Sharif Thana Golamber in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table bookings and food menu discovery.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital menu, aur location directions integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mahfil

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Mahfil Cafe & Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu showcase, and your landmark location near Phulwari Sharif Thana Golamber. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual interior photos aur pricing setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
